title: Enter your code
lede: Enter your email address and the six-digit code we sent to it.
ledeKnown: We sent a six-digit code to {email}. Enter it below to finish creating your account.
codeHint: The code expires 5 minutes after it was sent and stops working after 5 wrong attempts.

resent: If that address still needs confirming, a new code is on its way. Earlier codes no longer work.
resendFailed: Could not send a new code.
verified: Your address is confirmed and your account is active. You can sign in now.
